integrity: Explicit elementary proof and reproducible brute-force finite-field checker. Self-review only; no independent audit or independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Counts F_q-linear subalgebras of split free two-block class-two Lie algebras only, not arbitrary additive subgroups, p-adic lattice subalgebras, or isomorphism classes. The a=b=1 Heisenberg case is previously known; the originality claim is the all-rank Goursat refinement and general a,b family. Equivalent prior counts in older unindexed subring-zeta work remain a priority risk. Finite checks do not prove the general formula.
title: Goursat-refined subalgebra counts in bipartite class-two Lie algebras over finite fields
